explain.held: Another merge or local integration held this project's checkout when the merge was tried, so Orchester refused before Git ran: nothing was merged, and the run's branch and the checkout are as they were. Try again once it ends; a run in the merge queue waits for it by itself.
explain.refusedBeforeGit: Orchester refused at {{stage}} before Git ran: {{cause}}. Nothing was merged, and the run's branch and the checkout are as they were. Try again once that is fixed.
explain.refusedInQueue: The merge queue tried the merge, and Orchester refused at {{stage}} before Git ran: {{cause}}. Nothing was merged. Fix that, or wait for it, then Try again: the run goes back to its place in the merge queue.
explain.refusedAt: {{stage}} refused the merge: {{cause}}. Nothing was merged.
explain.queueStopped: The merge queue stopped before the merge began: {{cause}}. Nothing was merged. Try again puts the run back in its place in the queue.
explain.conflictsOne: Git could not merge the run's branch into {{branch}} on its own: both changed the same lines in 1 file. Nothing was merged; Git's merge was aborted, so {{branch}} and the checkout are as they were. Resolve the conflicts in the run's worktree, or ask an agent to.
explain.conflictsOther: Git could not merge the run's branch into {{branch}} on its own: both changed the same lines in {{count}} files. Nothing was merged; Git's merge was aborted, so {{branch}} and the checkout are as they were. Resolve the conflicts in the run's worktree, or ask an agent to.
explain.notRecorded: Git merged the run into {{branch}} as {{revision}}, but Orchester could not record it: {{cause}}. Your code is in {{branch}}. Record merge saves the merge Git made, marks the task done and clears the run's worktree; it does not merge again.
explain.gitStopped: Git could not finish {{stage}}: {{cause}}. Orchester stopped it, with every program it started, and removed its temporary worktree. Your checkout and {{branch}} were not touched: the merge commit is made beside them. Try again once the disk answers.
explain.gitSilent: Git wrote nothing for {{time}} at {{stage}}, most likely because the disk stopped answering. Orchester stopped it, with every program it started, and removed its temporary worktree. Your checkout and {{branch}} were not touched: the merge commit is made beside them. Try again once the disk answers.
explain.leftChangedOne: Git stopped part way while it brought the finished merge into your checkout, and {{branch}} did not move. Orchester put back what it could; 1 file still holds the merge's version. Put it back, then Try again. Nothing you changed yourself is touched.
explain.leftChangedOther: Git stopped part way while it brought the finished merge into your checkout, and {{branch}} did not move. Orchester put back what it could; {{count}} files still hold the merge's version. Put them back, then Try again. Nothing you changed yourself is touched.
explain.interrupted: The app or the runner ended while the merge was at {{stage}}: {{cause}}. Orchester cleared what the merge left when it started again, and nothing was merged. Try again.
explain.moved: {{branch}} or the run's branch moved since the run was checked: {{cause}}. Nothing was merged; Try again merges the run as it is now.
explain.movedBefore: {{branch}} or the run's branch moved since the run was checked, before the merge began. Nothing was merged; Try again merges the run as it is now.
explain.retrying: Orchester could not merge: {{cause}}. That usually passes in seconds, so Orchester tries again by itself. Nothing was merged so far; the checkout and {{branch}} are as they were.
explain.queueRetries: Orchester could not merge: {{cause}}. The merge queue tries again when it gets to the run; nothing was merged so far.
explain.mergedAfterOne: Merged into {{branch}} as {{revision}} on attempt {{attempt}}. The attempt before it did not land, and nothing of it stayed behind.
explain.mergedAfterOther: Merged into {{branch}} as {{revision}} on attempt {{attempt}}. The {{count}} attempts before it did not land, and nothing of theirs stayed behind.
explain.recorded: Merged into {{branch}} as {{revision}}: Orchester recorded the merge Git made.
